newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse to invest 600 mln Sfr in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse to invest 600 mln Sfr in 1996.

text.p: Swiss aluminium, packaging and chemicals group Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG said it would invest over 600 million Swiss francs in fixed assets this year, including 120 million in Switzerland.
Alusuisse said in its interim statement that together with 550 million Swiss francs in acquisition costs, its gearing is expected to remain at the level reached at the end of June.
Alusuisse's debt-to-equity ratio at the end of the first half rose to 0.95 from 0.91 at mid-1995.
Of the 600 million, Alusuisse invested 221 million in the first half. At the end of June Alusuisse's cash and marketable securities had fallen to 247 million francs from 368 million.

In order to provide the group with the least costly form of financing, Alusuisse launched a $250 million convertible eurobond early this year and a 240 million Swiss franc convertible in the second half of 1995.

Alusuisse said these bonds provided the group with more than 25 percent of its current debt in the form of "quasi-equity" which, if not coverted, will mature no earlier than 2001. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
